## Personality

Thomas Lynde is a meek, quiet, and unobtrusive man who lives a low-profile life. Characterized by a lack of willpower, he is easily ruled by others, particularly by a clever and capable manager.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P13](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0013), [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P0](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0000)_

## History

Thomas Lynde spent his early life ruled by his mother until he married [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who took over managing him. Later in life, he suffered from declining health, which was discussed by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) as his condition grew worse. Thomas eventually passed away, leaving behind his widow, [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md), who was subsequently invited to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could leave for [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER I. ## Relationships

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/rachel-lynde--thomas-lynde.md)

Thomas Lynde is married to [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), remaining her husband throughout their time in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). While [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) frequently engages in local gossip and visits neighbors like [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to discuss community news, Thomas shares a household with her as she manages domestic affairs and keeps track of neighborhood events.
